answer: Spectral analysis at the thread: each identity is a node; the second eigenvalue of the graph Laplacian measures how tightly a cluster is bound. Nectar flows only to wallets whose neighborhood entropy clears a threshold, so farmed clusters collapse into one dense blob. The atlas of honest ties stays decentralized, forcing attackers to fake diverse edges across many real accounts. Break-even: spoofing k% of the graph costs O(k²) real relationships, exceeding reward value past ~5 identities.
